rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pattern for doing something accurately or precisely.

example.english: I record every number accurately, so it is easier to check the figures later.
example.traditional: 我準確咁記低每個數，之後對數就容易啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeon2 kok3 gam3 gei3 dai1 mui5 go3 sou3 zi1 hau6 deoi3 sou3 zau6 jung4 ji6 di1

rows.note: Use this after the verb when emphasizing that the result or performance is accurate.

example.english: They quote prices accurately, so the customers feel reassured.
example.traditional: 佢哋報價報得準確，客人都好放心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 bou3 gaa3 bou3 dak1 zeon2 kok3 haak3 jan4 dou1 hou2 fong3 sam1
